comparison.objective: Release a spring clamp and extract a screwdriver into a verified pinch grasp; candidate adjusts switch mounts using a screwdriver.
comparison.physical_skill: Clamp actuation plus tool extraction and isolated grasp versus tool-tip alignment, partial screw loosening, sensor sliding, and retightening.
comparison.success_condition: Tool physically clears clamp and is held at a target for 1 s without unsafe motion; candidate requires two retained sensor registrations.
comparison.reason: Using a screwdriver as an extracted object does not duplicate using one for precision calibration. Candidate tool-slot geometry and torque thresholds remain missing.
